lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular white spots arranged in horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with inter-spot distances approximately three times the diameter of individual blobs.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of slightly elevated pixel intensity that align with the vertical axes of the high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal feature at the top of the visible frame characterized by a high-contrast transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: Dense population of smaller, high-luminance spots distributed across the visible surface of the pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger, more widely spaced blobs on the flank.
